issue.title: test_no_open_phases_raises flakes under full just check lane
issue.description:
## Flake report

- Test: tests/test_bead/test_work_epic_plan.py::TestEpicValidation::test_no_open_phases_raises
- Repro: just check after diff-scoped selection escalates to the full suite

During this turn required just check, the scoped lane escalated to the full 14-worker suite because of core-identity-changed and failed only tests/test_bead/test_work_epic_plan.py::TestEpicValidation::test_no_open_phases_raises after 36,085 tests passed, 12 skipped, and 65 warnings. The current implementation diff does not touch bead epic-plan validation. An immediate rerun on the same tree with uv run pytest tests/test_bead/test_work_epic_plan.py::TestEpicValidation::test_no_open_phases_raises -vv passed. Observed fail/pass rate is 1 failure in the full parallel lane followed by 1 isolated serial pass; it did not reproduce serially.

task_type_fields.evidence: Required just check escalated to the full 14-worker suite and failed only this node after 36,085 passes / 12 skips / 65 warnings. Immediate same-tree isolated rerun with uv run pytest tests/test_bead/test_work_epic_plan.py::TestEpicValidation::test_no_open_phases_raises -vv passed. Observed fail/pass rate: 1 full-parallel failure, 1 isolated pass; serial reproduction did not occur.

payload.entry: Additional evidence from the second verification attempt in this same turn: after rerunning just check, test-scoped again escalated to the full 14-worker suite and again failed tests/test_bead/test_work_epic_plan.py::TestEpicValidation::test_no_open_phases_raises. The run reached 36,083 passed / 12 skipped / 65 warnings and then was interrupted after 38m37s because the xdist controller and sampled workers were idle in execnet waits. Before this second full-lane attempt, the exact node passed in isolated serial rerun on the same tree. This strengthens the classification as full-parallel/order-dependent rather than a deterministic node failure.

Follow-up confirmation after the second full-lane failure: uv run pytest tests/test_bead/test_work_epic_plan.py::TestEpicValidation::test_no_open_phases_raises -vv passed again in isolation on the same tree (1 passed in 2.67s).

payload.close_reason: Obsolete: the flaked node no longer exists. TestEpicValidation::test_no_open_phases_raises was removed and replaced by test_no_phase_children_raises in 22a2937e4 'fix(bead): relaunch lander after closed epic phases' (2026-08-22), which also added test_all_closed_phases_return_and_render_land_only_plan because all-closed-phases is no longer an error. Verified 2026-08-24 at 45806495f: 'test_no_open_phases_raises' matches nothing in the repo.
